version_desc:
version: 3.1.24
版本更新：
- One-tap update: download and install the new version (#9)
- Fix Windows QR login blank page, Douyin danmaku CSRF, cookie sync on first join (#8)
- ci: fix SIGPIPE in version.json release step (#7)
- Sync Bilibili/Douyin follows, auto-release on merge, louder stereo audio (#6)
- ci: skip MSIX when signing secrets are missing (#5)
- Add server sync, Douyin QR login and real danmaku sending (#4)
- ci: build debug-signed test APK when signing secrets are missing
- Add in-app Huya login and followed-room sync (#3)
- fix(auth): fall back to browser link GitHub login on Android (#2)
- fix(volume): default mobile playback volume to 100% (#1)
